def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None and (sep_row is None or sep_col < sep_row):
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        a = [row[:] for row in grid[:sep_row]]
        b = [row[:] for row in grid[sep_row + 1:]]
    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
